title: THE COST FAILURE CLASS (harvest of cc3's B8139) + the fast lane: a lock never REACHED catches nothing — main audited clean of the drift, and the suite given an inner-loop lane so the class stops recurring
the_finding_harvested: cc3 named a NEW failure class -- 'cost': a lock that exists, works, and was never weakened, but is never REACHED because the suite is too expensive to run (their suite: 1038 files / 4528 tests, 421 s to COLLECT alone; two background runs killed by timeout). The concrete drift it let through: cc3's seat stopped writing FINDINGS.md at B8110 and it ran unbroken for 16 arcs / 5 days. Every remedy for a missing/weak/silent check is useless against cost. It surfaced only because cc3 read a run KILLED at 73% -- 'a killed run is not a run that told you nothing' (the same discipline that saved this seat's C4 partial reads).

main_band_audit.scope: 1043 arc_verdict.json on main, the 4 drift classes cc3 found
main_band_audit.findings_completeness: CLEAN -- every arc carries FINDINGS.md except B519 (RETRACTED), which records its result in VERDICT.md, a convention already LOCKED on main (test_b810_wave1 accepts FINDINGS.md OR VERDICT.md; test_b826/b819/b817/b818). Not drift.
main_band_audit.instrument_bool: CLEAN -- 0 arcs carry instrument as a string (all bool)
main_band_audit.verdict_vocabulary: CLEAN -- 0 verdicts outside {PROVED, NEGATIVE, OPEN, RETRACTED}
main_band_audit.negative_routing: CLEAN -- 0 unrouted NEGATIVE arcs (B1151 routed this cycle)
main_band_audit.conclusion: cc3's drift was BAND-LOCAL. Main held -- because main's suite GETS RUN each bank while cc3's does not complete. Same trajectory though: main's collection alone is already >120 s (this seat hit it: a --co run timed out at 120 s this session; a full run is ~22 min), and this seat already had to green a tree by input-change analysis rather than a clean re-run. Preventive, not just curative.

cost_diagnosis.full_collect: >120 s (a --co run timed out) -- so the cost is import-time work SPREAD across many test modules (module-level compute), not fixed overhead
cost_diagnosis.mechanism: pytest imports EVERY test module before running any test (documented in tests/conftest.py, the R22-4 module-level-dps sweep). Module-level computation in test files therefore runs at COLLECTION, and its sum is the collection cost. `-m 'not slow'` cannot help collection (the modules still import).
cost_diagnosis.per_file_breakdown: the single-file collect (1.17 s) vs the full collect (>120 s) already establishes the cost is SPREAD across many module-level importers; a per-file breakdown to NAME the worst offenders is the first step of the L184 root-fix follow-up

remedy.slow_marker: registered the `slow` pytest marker (tests/conftest.py pytest_configure) -- kills the UnknownMark warning and enables `-m 'not slow'` to skip expensive tests at EXECUTION time
remedy.changed_file_selector: scripts/affected_tests.py -- maps the working-tree (or a diff range) to ONLY the affected test files, so pytest collects a handful in seconds. CONSERVATIVE: any change it cannot bound (scripts code, conftest, unknown) falls back to the FULL suite -- never a false green. Validated: a typical bank (frontier arc + CHANGELOG/PROGRESS/RELAY + views) maps to 49 test files INCLUDING the corpus-aggregate + gate tests (test_repo_gates, test_b833 negative-routing -- the very test that caught B1151's routing this cycle), not the full ~140.
remedy.runner_modes: scripts/run_suite.sh gains --changed (the selector) and --fast (-m 'not slow'); --serial/full stay the certificate of record.
remedy.not_fixed: the ROOT collection cost is not yet fixed -- the selector AVOIDS it for the inner loop; a lazy-fy of the slowest module-level importers (moving compute into fixtures/functions) so even the FULL suite collects fast is the named follow-up (L-registered).

fences: This is a METHOD/tooling bank, no mathematics. The full suite remains the certificate of record (the ARBITER RULE / B1018 stands); the fast lane is the inner loop, not a replacement for the pre-commit certificate. The selector's safety is its FULL fallback -- it is only ever a SUPERSET-or-FULL selector, proven by test. cc3 credited (the finding + the name). The email-on-a-public-surface flag cc3 raised (SUBMISSION_METADATA.md) is on THEIR branch and is the OWNER's decision -- surfaced, not touched here.
